kind: v0.29 earned source-engine preset-context measurement; not browser or UI-cancel acceptance

protocol.acquisition: Fresh stage1 Balanced defaults, exactly30 attempts per fixed seed unless start-blocked/censored. Before each attempt choose highest-score owned item per slot (current/earlier item wins ties), then try legal learn/slot actions for all3 existing rank1 lines. Each start requests finishThenCamp. No potions, commission, sales, binding, IW, upgrades, resource/stat/RNG edits or extra attempts. Retain every defeat/censor/missing-family result.
protocol.presets: After acquisition, save the first held axe/rapier/club (equipped item then backpack order) in A/B/C, retaining current armor/accessory; restore the acquisition weapon. Missing families are recorded without replacement or extra runs. No random item is created for a test.
protocol.profiles: Independent copies of the same prepared earned save: A Balanced/front/ProtectionOFF/supplyOFF/all3 learned abilities slotted; B Assault/caster/ProtectionON only if naturally unlocked/supplyON/HP+1H slotted; C Sustain/weakest/ProtectionOFF/supplyON retained/HP+MP slotted. Keep earned ranks and record locked Protection or already-current gear without forcing a swap.
protocol.observation: Inspect exact gear preview, prove full state/RNG unchanged, apply only a valid non-active exact quote, prove current policies/ability allocation and all owned item bytes unchanged. Already-active application is a complete no-op. Run one stage1 expedition for each available family and check actual start report against that branch configuration. No causal speed/survival comparison is made across different gear or policies.
